sources.name: NTIA, The Minimum Elements For a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), 2021-07
과학기술정보통신부·국가정보원·KISA, SW 공급망 보안 가이드라인 1.0, 2024-05 (형식 비특정, 핵심 구성요소는 NTIA 최소 요소와 같은 7종)
sources.name_en: Ministry of Science and ICT / National Intelligence Service / KISA, SW Supply Chain Security Guideline 1.0, 2024-05 (format-agnostic; the 7 core elements match the NTIA minimum elements)

sources.name: 과학기술정보통신부·국가정보원, SW 공급망 보안 로드맵, 2026-06-24 (공공분야 SBOM 제출 2027년까지 제도화)
sources.name_en: Ministry of Science and ICT / National Intelligence Service, SW Supply Chain Security Roadmap, 2026-06-24 (public-sector SBOM submission to be institutionalized by 2027)

elements.label: 공급자
elements.hint: component 의 supplier(또는 publisher·manufacturer). 주 component 는 generate_egovframe_sbom(supplier=…) 또는 pom <organization><name> 으로 채웁니다.
elements.hint_en: supplier (or publisher/manufacturer) of the component. For the main component it is filled from generate_egovframe_sbom(supplier=…) or pom <organization><name>.

elements.label: 의존관계
elements.hint: dependencies[] 에 그 component 의 bom-ref 항목(의존이 없으면 빈 dependsOn)
elements.hint_en: An entry for the component's bom-ref in dependencies[] (empty dependsOn when it has none)

elements.label: 작성자
elements.hint: metadata.authors — 생성 도구(metadata.tools)만으로는 작성 주체가 드러나지 않습니다. generate_egovframe_sbom(author=…)
elements.hint_en: metadata.authors — the generating tool (metadata.tools) alone does not identify who authored it. generate_egovframe_sbom(author=…)

suppliers.name: The Apache Software Foundation
suppliers.basis: groupId org.apache — iBATIS 2.x 는 ASF 프로젝트(은퇴)
suppliers.basis_en: groupId org.apache — iBATIS 2.x is an ASF project (retired)

suppliers.name: Unicode, Inc.
suppliers.basis_en: pom <url> https://icu.unicode.org/ (ICU is a Unicode project)
